desc:
🏁 RACE UPDATE! 6 race stations, top 3 statues, a RACE menu and a snowy Usui Pass at night.
🛴 WHEELIE A KUKIRIN | Escooter Simulator
Ride a Kukirin, Dualtron, Kaabo or Ninebot escooter (e-scooter, electric scooter) across a huge open city, pop wheelies, outrun the police and work your way up from a Ninebot F to the 270 km/h Dualtron X Limited.

🔥 FEATURES
🛴 21 real e-scooters: Kukirin, Dualtron, Kaabo, Teverun, Ninebot and more
⚡ Top speeds from 100 to 270 km/h
🏍️ Wheelies pay double cash
🏁 Drag races and time trials on 6 courses
💰 Earn cash every second you ride
🚓 Police chases up to 5 stars: escape for a big bounty
🔧 Tune your motor, controller and tires at the Pit Stop
📦 Delivery jobs all over the map
🛣️ Downtown, Port, Beach, Old Town, Suburbs, Hills and an Airfield drag strip

🎁 CODES: WHEELIE, KUKIRIN

⭐ Favorite + Like for more scooters and updates!

Fan-made game. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Kukirin or any scooter brand.
